flowchart LR
    user((User)) --> cdn[CDN]
    cdn --> lb[Load balancer]
    subgraph edge [Edge tier]
        cdn
        lb
    end
    subgraph core [Core services]
        subgraph api [API]
            gw[Gateway] --> auth[Auth service]
            gw --> orders[Orders service]
            gw --> catalog[Catalog service]
        end
        subgraph workers [Workers]
            q[[Job queue]] --> mail[Mailer]
            q --> billing[Billing worker]
            q --> index[Search indexer]
        end
        orders --> q
        catalog --> q
    end
    lb --> gw
    subgraph data [Data]
        pg[(Postgres)]
        redis[(Redis)]
        es[(Search)]
        s3[(Object store)]
    end
    auth --> redis
    orders --> pg
    catalog --> pg
    catalog --> redis
    index --> es
    billing --> pg
    mail --> s3
